paragraphs.source_en: It was already after New Year in the twentieth year of Keichō when the dismantling of Osaka Castle’s defenses and the filling of its inner and outer moats set tongues wagging throughout the castle.

units.source_en: It was already after New Year in the twentieth year of Keichō when the dismantling of Osaka Castle’s defenses and the filling of its inner and outer moats set tongues wagging throughout the castle.

ja.t: ぎてからのことだった。

units.source_zh: 大坂城护城的拆除，以及内外护城河的填埋，让城内议论纷纷，已是庆长二十年新年过后之事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大坂城护城的拆除，以及内外护城河的填埋，让城内议论纷纷，已是庆长二十年新年过后之事。

paragraphs.source_en: In the eyes of the hereditary daimyō of the Tokugawa house, the rōnin had fallen into great disorder around the time the peace settlement was concluded. Sanada Yukimura, Gotō Mototsugu, and the others had persistently urged Hideyori to fight, but after that earthshaking cannonade, most of those in the castle visibly lost the will to do battle. Perhaps sensing how it would all end, most of them raised a clamor for a time and then fell silent.

units.source_en: In the eyes of the hereditary daimyō of the Tokugawa house, the rōnin had fallen into great disorder around the time the peace settlement was concluded.
units.source_zh: 在德川家谱代大名的眼里，议和成功前后，浪人内部已大为混乱。

units.source_en: Sanada Yukimura, Gotō Mototsugu, and the others had persistently urged Hideyori to fight, but after that earthshaking cannonade, most of those in the castle visibly lost the will to do battle.
units.source_zh: 真田幸村、后藤基次等人始终积极催促秀赖一战，可是自从那震天的大炮轰击之后，城内大多数人眼看着失去了战意。

units.source_en: Perhaps sensing how it would all end, most of them raised a clamor for a time and then fell silent.
units.source_zh: 他们怕都预感到了最终的结局，大多叫嚣一通，便偃旗息鼓了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在德川家谱代大名的眼里，议和成功前后，浪人内部已大为混乱。真田幸村、后藤基次等人始终积极催促秀赖一战，可是自从那震天的大炮轰击之后，城内大多数人眼看着失去了战意。他们怕都预感到了最终的结局，大多叫嚣一通，便偃旗息鼓了。

paragraphs.source_en: The rōnin were treated to a feast and given some silver, whereupon they vied with one another to leave the castle. Osaka at year’s end suddenly took on an air of bustling festivity.

units.source_en: The rōnin were treated to a feast and given some silver, whereupon they vied with one another to leave the castle.
units.source_zh: 浪人被赐了酒宴，又领了些银子，便争先恐后出到城外。

units.source_en: Osaka at year’s end suddenly took on an air of bustling festivity.
units.source_zh: 岁末的大坂顿时呈现出一派热闹景象。

paragraphs.source_en: “What in the world is going on? Didn’t the peace agreement say that only the outer moat was to be filled?” The first to voice this doubt was a certain Inoue, a retainer of Sengoku Sōya.

paragraphs.source_en: There was, of course, no possibility that Harunaga did not know. Yet he pretended to have learned of it only then and feigned alarm as he sent a messenger to question Matsudaira Tadaaki and the others: “The agreement reached in the peace talks was that only the outer works would be demolished. Why are the inner works being torn down as well?”

paragraphs.source_en: Tadaaki thereupon consulted Honda Tadamasa, lord of the hundred-thousand-koku domain of Kuwana in Ise, who was working alongside him. Tadamasa replied, “This is the Retired Shogun’s command. The Retired Shogun ordered us to fill the entire circuit of castle moats. The ‘entire circuit of castle moats’ plainly means every moat, with no distinction between inner and outer.”

paragraphs.source_en: Tadamasa, Tadaaki, and Yasunori had probably discussed the matter beforehand with Honda Masazumi, which was why they could now give such a reply. On hearing the answer, Ōno Harunaga remained silent for two or three days.

paragraphs.source_en: But throughout that time, the filling continued. Akashi Tango, Gotō Matabei, Mōri Buzen, Ikoma Masazumi, and others then began voicing their grievances one after another.

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, Ōno Harunaga sent a second messenger, this time not to the three magistrates but directly to seek an audience with Honda Masazumi. paragraphs.source_en: Because these rumors mingled truth with falsehood, a story seeking to shift responsibility for the war onto the rōnin immediately spread among the remorseful Toyotomi retainers and the merchant houses sympathetic to the Toyotomi clan. In fact, the rumors had come from laborers belonging to the Date and Tōdō houses; sadly, not a single person investigated them carefully.
